meta.grade_rationale: 3 P1 CVEs exceed Grade C ceiling (max_p1=2). Spec coverage 97% (excellent). Fix P1 CVEs to move grade to B.

escalations.title: JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion — potential RCE
escalations.action_required: Confirm whether handlebars is used for user-controlled template compilation anywhere in the codebase. If yes, treat as critical RCE and block deployment.

escalations.title: Missing buffer bounds check in uuid v3/v5/v6 with explicit buffer
escalations.action_required: Run static analysis to verify buffer-passing patterns in Source/Backend/**/*.ts. If uuid is called with caller-provided buffers, memory corruption is possible.
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update uuid  # Major bump to >= 11.1.1 required

p1_findings.title: handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.priority: Block deployment — verify with TheGuardians first

p1_findings.title: brace-expansion DoS — 4 CVEs allowing unbounded expansion (CVSS 7.5)
js-yaml Quadratic-Complexity DoS — 3 CVEs via YAML merge-key chains (CVSS 7.5)

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer never scans portal/ — 70+ FRs invisible to CI gate
p2_findings.fix: Add 'portal' to source_dirs list at line 60 in tools/traceability-enforcer.py

p2_findings.title: Direct DB calls in route handler — service layer bypassed in teamDispatches.ts
p2_findings.fix: Extract teamDispatchService.ts with listDispatches() and recordDispatch() functions; route handlers call service only

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field names (CVSS 7.5)
express + qs DoS via null handling in qs.stringify (CVSS 5.3, direct dependency)
uuid missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 (CVSS 7.5, direct dependency)
p2_findings.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update uuid  # Major version bump to >= 11.1.1

p3_findings.title: Duplicate WorkItemDetailPage test file — ambiguous canonical location
p3_findings.fix: Delete root-level file; keep Source/Frontend/tests/pages/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx as canonical

p3_findings.title: FR-DUP-06 has no Verifies comment — detail-always-returns behavior untestable
p3_findings.fix: Add test in portal/Backend/tests/ asserting GET by ID returns duplicate-status items; tag // Verifies: FR-DUP-06

p3_findings.title: FR-TMP-008 has no Verifies comment — worker container prerequisites untraced
p3_findings.fix: Add # Verifies: FR-TMP-008 comment to platform/Dockerfile.worker (solo-session only)

p3_findings.title: 5 portal files exceed 500-line threshold (max 550 lines)
p3_findings.fix: Split detail components into sub-components; extract completionService; split featureRequestService at CRUD/voting boundary

p3_findings.title: @remix-run/router open redirect via protocol-relative URLs
p3_findings.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update react-router-dom  # Target: >= 6.30.4

p3_findings.title: esbuild dev server information disclosure (dev-only, CVSS 5.3)
p3_findings.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite  # Pulls esbuild >= 0.25.0

p3_findings.title: nanoid infinite loop on negative/zero size (CVSS 5.9)
express 2+ major versions behind (4.18.2, latest 5.2.1)
p3_findings.fix: Stay on 4.x — update to 4.22.2+ within current major

p3_findings.title: pino 2+ major versions behind (8.17.0, latest 10.3.1)
p3_findings.fix: Update to 8.21.0+; plan v9+ migration for performance improvements

p3_findings.title: uuid 5+ major versions behind (9.0.0, latest 14.0.1)

p3_findings.title: React 1 major version behind (18.3.1, latest 19.2.8)
p3_findings.fix: Currently on latest 18.x — plan v19 migration when stable

p3_findings.title: react-router-dom 1 major version behind (6.26.0, latest 7.18.2)
p3_findings.fix: Update to 6.30.4+ first (includes open-redirect fix); plan v7 migration

p4_findings.title: Two logger abstractions in Source/Backend — legacy wrapper unfixed

p4_findings.title: eslint-disable-next-line without justification in 2 frontend files
p4_findings.fix: Add inline comment explaining why dependency is intentionally omitted

p4_findings.title: @babel/core arbitrary local file read via malicious source map (CVSS 3.2, dev-only)
